name: Missing Employee ID — Error Handling
goal: Bot handles missing employee_id by displaying only the exact error message.
constraints: Employee details fetch returns no employee_id (null/empty/undefined).

phases.description: Bot attempts to fetch employee details but employee_id is missing.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays only: 'There is some issue in fetching your details.' and marks task as done.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
